messages:
maya.ops: RCA is live here: https://internal.redwood/rca/3001112222. Short summary: during a model rollout a mismatched quantization table was applied to a canary shard, which produced out-of-range logits and caused inference failures ~09:14-09:32. We reverted the rollout and re-provisioned the canary with the correct quant table. Action checklist is at the bottom of the doc; please claim or ack items by EOD.

deploy-bot: Timeline (auto): 09:02 start rollout -> 09:09 canary errors spike -> 09:18 rollback initiated -> 09:25 full rollback -> 09:32 canary reprovisioned -> 09:35 stable. Artifacts: sample failure traces, quant metadata diffs, and canary logs attached.

chris.eng: I'll own "verify quant table provenance". Plan: add a deploy-time checksum that verifies quant table version against model manifest and halt rollouts on mismatch. ETA: Wed 2024-06-12. I'll open the PR and drop the link here.

olivia.prod: I'll draft a short note for CSMs explaining impact and mitigation in plain language. Will post draft for review by tomorrow AM. Any specific phrasing requests? Keep it concise: what happened, who was affected, what we fixed, and next steps.

zane.sre: I'll take "canary validation + synthetic coverage". Steps: extend canary tests to include a small set of golden prompts run with each quant variant and add an alert if output distributions diverge. Proposed checkpoint: Mon 2024-06-17 10:00 PT. Can folks confirm?

support-bot: Support summary: 5 tickets opened during window; most were timeout errors. Links to customer threads added to the RCA.

maya.ops: Office hours to walk through RCA and assign unclaimed items: Thu 2024-06-13 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Please post questions here before the meeting.

chris.eng: \u2705 taking the quant provenance item. Will add unit+integration tests.

olivia.prod: \u2705 will post draft by tomorrow; ping @chris.eng for technical check.

zane.sre: \u2705 checkpoint confirmed.

support-bot: Added links to the customer-facing replies; recommend we send a short blurb once PRs are in.

maya.ops: Two asks: 1) owners, react with :white_check_mark: to accept; 2) paste PRs, test run screenshots, and alert rule configs back into this thread so I can close items after the one-week verification window. If anything urgent, escalate in #eng-oncall.

chris.eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/model-deploy/pull/712 (checksum + manifest validation). Posting unit test logs shortly.

olivia.prod: Draft blurb posted for review: "We observed a brief disruption for inference requests during a model rollout due to a configuration mismatch. The issue is resolved; engineers have added checks to prevent recurrence. No customer data was exposed. For customers with sensitive SLAs, please contact your CSM." Feedback welcome.

zane.sre: Uploaded canary test screenshots and proposed alert threshold.

maya.ops: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the office hours and update the RCA with verification evidence. Aim to close actions after the one-week watch unless new issues appear.
